events.title: Middle Grade Book Club: The Wish Ring Cipher

cases.refreshed: It's the next meeting of our middle grade book club for ages 9+! Led by bookseller extraordinaire Lorilee, we hope to introduce interested readers to amazing new books and the opportunity to talk about them in a fun, relaxed group setting. This month's book is The Wish Ring Cipher by Alexandra Ott, a fast paced adventure novel filled with puzzle solving, a hint of magic, and new school fears. Please email lorilee@lindentreebooks.com to RSVP. Emma Avery has always loved solving puzzles and codes, and now that she's processing a recent autism diagnosis and facing down seventh grade at a new school, they're even more important to her. Then Emma meets Nate Lin. He's popular and funny and... loves codes, too. He introduces Emma to the Codebreakers, a group of his friends dedicated to cracking codes that have been discovered in the ruins of a nearby ghost town, which are believed to lead to magical objects. But they're not the only ones on the hunt, and when their sinister rivals close in on an object that grants unlimited wishes, the Codebreakers must race to beat them to it before they use it for dark magic.

events.title: Everyone Can Code: Rock, Paper, Scissors Using Swift Playgrounds

cases.refreshed: Create your own rock, paper, scissors game using Swift Playground! Everyone Can Code is a beginner's course on using iPads to code and modify technology, such as online games. Students will be learning the basics of coding and implementing them through the modification of rock, paper, scissors. Everything needed for this course will be provided, but you are more than welcome to bring your own personal iPad with the free Swift Playgrounds app downloaded, especially if you want to save your work. Free. Registration is recommended. This series is taught in English only. Registration closes at 12 PM the day before class. However, if seats are still available, students in grades 3-6 can walk in on Saturday if they arrive before 3 PM to sign in. Maximum class size is 25. Although the class is scheduled from 3-4:30 PM, students who finish their projects early are welcome to leave early. Todos pueden programar: Piedra, papel o tijera con Swift Playgrounds ¡Crea tu propio juego de piedra, papel o tijera usando Swift Playgrounds! Sábado 31 de octubre de 2026 de 3 a 4:30 horas 'Todos pueden programar' es un curso para principiantes que enseña a utilizar iPads para programar y modificar tecnología, como los juegos en línea. Los estudiantes aprenderán los conceptos básicos de la programación y los pondrán en práctica modificando el juego de piedra, papel o tijera. Todo lo necesario para este curso será proporcionado, pero puedes traer tu propio iPad personal con la aplicación gratuita Swift Playgrounds descargada, especialmente si deseas guardar tu trabajo. Gratis. Se recomienda registrarse con anticipación. Esta serie será enseñada únicamente en inglés. La inscripción cierra a las 12 p.m. el día antes de la clase. Si quedan espacios disponibles, los alumnos de grado 3 a 6 pueden venir el sábado e inscribirse antes de las 15:00 p.m. La clase tiene un cupo máximo de 25 alumnos. Aunque la clase está programada de 3-4:30 p.m., los alumnos que terminan sus proyectos antes podrán retirarse si lo desean. Everyone Can Code: Trò Chơi Kéo-Búa-Bao với Swift Playgrounds Thứ Bảy, ngày 31 tháng 10 năm 2026 từ 3-4:30 giờ chiều Hãy tự tạo trò chơi Kéo-Búa-Bao cho riêng quý vị bằng Swift Playgrounds! "Everyone Can Code" là khóa học dành cho người mới bắt đầu, hướng dẫn cách sử dụng iPad để lập trình và sửa đổi kỹ thuật công nghệ, chẳng hạn như trò chơi trực tuyến. Học viên sẽ học những kiến thức lập trình cơ bản và áp dụng chúng thông qua việc sửa đổi của trò chơi Kéo-Búa-Bao. Mọi thứ cần thiết cho khóa học này sẽ được cung cấp, nhưng bạn hoàn toàn có thể mang theo iPad cá nhân của mình với ứng dụng Swift Playgrounds miễn phí đã tải xuống, đặc biệt khi bạn muốn lưu tác phẩm của mình. Miễn phí. Xin vui lòng ghi danh trước. Lớp học được chỉ dạy hoàn toàn bằng tiếng anh. Thời hạn ghi danh kết thúc vào 12 giờ trưa ngày trước khi lớp học bắt đầu. Tuy nhiên, nếu vẫn còn chỗ trống, học sinh lớp 3-6 có thể đến trực tiếp vào thứ Bảy nếu đến trước 3 giờ chiều để điểm danh. Lớp học tối đa là 25 học sinh. Mặc dù lớp học được lên lịch từ 3 đến 4 giờ 30 chiều, nhưng học sinh nào hoàn thành bài tập sớm có thể về sớm. Yêu cầu các phương tiện cho ADA

events.title: Crafternoon for Adults, Tweens and Teens

cases.refreshed: Come unwind and learn something new at our monthly crafternoon! No experience is necessary. Supplies will be provided, and you're welcome to bring any of your own. In fact some of these crafts may benefit from your personal stash! The activities will be suitable for ages 10 and up. We will have project samples each day to help you visualize the end result. Programs will be on the fourth Sunday of the month. • October – Cardboard Nicho Recommended items to bring: small images of a cherished item, symbol, memory, or a loved one you miss. • November – Embossing Aluminum Food Charms Recommended items to bring: colorful sharpies • December – Felt and Beaded Patches Recommended items to bring: old jewelry you don't mind disassembling, beads, colorful thread, loose buttons, scraps of fabric and lace. ¡Ven a relajarte y a aprender algo nuevo en nuestra tarde mensual de artesanías! No se necesita experiencia. Se proporcionarán los materiales, pero puedes traer los que quieras. De hecho, ¡algunas de estas artesanías pueden beneficiarse de tus propios materiales! Las actividades serán aptas para mayores de 10 años. Cada día tendremos ejemplos de proyectos para ayudarte a visualizar el resultado final. • Agosto – Paisaje de playa en collage • Septiembre – Pintura de hongos • Octubre – Nicho de cartón Materiales recomendados para traer: imágenes pequeñas de un objeto preciado, un símbolo, un recuerdo o un ser querido al que extrañas. • Noviembre – Dijes de aluminio con relieve Artículos recomendados para traer: marcadores Sharpie de colores, piensa en cuál es tu comida reconfortante • Diciembre – Parches de fieltro y cuentas Artículos recomendados para traer: joyas viejas que no te importe desarmar, cuentas, hilo de colores, botones sueltos, retazos de tela y encaje.

events.title: Cult Movie: Sunday Matinee Movies: Chicken Run

cases.refreshed: Chicken Run is a wickedly funny, clever movie, which manages to be both kind and sweet. This is the first feature-length movie by Peter Lord and Nick Park, who created the wonderful Claymation, stop-action Wallace and Gromit movies. The movie opens with a spoof on World War II prison pictures such as "The Great Escape", but of course with chickens - specifically a chicken named Ginger. Ginger has tried and failed to escape the egg farm run by Mr. and Mrs. Tweedy, but ends up being caught and thrown into the coal bin time after time. But when Rocky the Flying Rooster arrives there is hope that all the chickens will learn the tools to escape before being turned into chicken pot pies! Doors open at 2:00 PM, and the movie begins at 2:10 PM. Adults need to stay in the room with their children.

(2009) Based on Demick's interviews over a seven year period with six North Koreans who escaped the country and the regime. The vast majority of North Koreans know little more of the world beyond their borders than the rest of the world knows about their daily lives under the Kim Jong-il regime. Without easy access to healthcare, experiencing frequent food shortages, life for the average working family in North Korea under Kim Jong-Il's rule is and was grim by Western standards. As of the publication date of this book, ordinary citizens have few if any civil rights and almost no recourse to protest injustice, as complaints and almost any sign of dissatisfaction with the regime could lead to imprisonment. events.title: Don't Get Scammed This Holiday Season

cases.refreshed: Online holiday shopping is convenient, but scammers are counting on you to be busy, rushed, and hunting for a good deal. As more of us turn to online shopping and charitable giving this time of year, fraudsters are getting better at looking legitimate. How can you tell if that website is a real store? Is that unbelievable social media deal actually a bargain, or a trap? And when you donate to a cause, how do you know your gift is going where you intended? Join us for a practical presentation that will help you shop and give with confidence. You'll learn how to: Verify that an online store is legitimate before you enter your credit card number; Read and understand product reviews, including how to spot fake or paid reviews; Recognize counterfeit and nonexistent products advertised on social media; Identify charity scams and make sure your donations reach the people and organizations you want to help. You'll leave with simple tips and a few trusted resources to help you stay safe shopping for the holidays and beyond. Keep on hand all season long. Whether you're a seasoned online shopper or just getting started, this program will help you protect your money, your personal information, and your holiday spirit. Bring your questions and your own stories. Your experience might help a neighbor avoid a scam too! Registration is recommended but NOT required. Register in order to receive a reminder email the day before the event.

event.title: Middle Grade Book Club: The Wish Ring Cipher
event.description: It’s the next meeting of our middle grade book club for ages 9+! Led by bookseller extraordinaire Lorilee, we hope to introduce interested readers to amazing new books and the opportunity to talk about them in a fun, relaxed group setting. Emma Avery has always loved solving puzzles and codes, and now that she’s processing a recent autism diagnosis and facing down seventh grade at a new school, they’re even more important to her. He introduces Emma to the Codebreakers, a group of his friends dedicated to cracking codes that have been discovered in the ruins of a nearby ghost town, which are believed to lead to magical objects. But they’re not the only ones on the hunt, and when their sinister rivals close in on an object that grants unlimited wishes, the Codebreakers must race to beat them to it before they use it for dark magic.
